head_candidate_atoms.trigger: During TDD, the public interface or seam shape is itself unsettled.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: Consult codebase-design vocabulary as a reference without starting a separate workflow session.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: A literal slash pointer can be reachable in Claude while dangling in Codex, or can accidentally start a second process instead of loading vocabulary.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: No local seam-failure sample shows benefit; first real seam ambiguity must prove shared catalog reach and reference-only loading in both harnesses.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A debugging run is about to show a command, output, or captured artifact.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: Every secret is replaced with a redaction marker before it is shown.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Masking only later prose still leaves raw tool output or transcripts exposed.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: This is the highest-priority safety increment, but it must be enforced at the producing command or script, not merely copied as prose.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A feedback loop needs authenticated access.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The credential remains in an environment variable instead of appearing in the displayed command.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Command arguments or shell expansion can leak credential values even if later artifacts are redacted.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Local systematic-debugging has source commands that expose values; those producers must be changed and canary-tested in Claude and Codex.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A captured trace contains authentication headers or other sensitive context.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: Only the lines carrying the diagnostic signal are quoted.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: A minimally useful quote can still become a wholesale artifact disclosure if selection is not enforced.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Port the least-data rule into the existing debug skill and verify raw artifact, transcript, and final report surfaces.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: Redacted evidence is insufficient to diagnose the bug.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The agent states the limitation and asks the user instead of exposing more data or guessing.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: A run may either leak more context or continue on an underdetermined diagnosis.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Keep as the safe degradation path after source-side filtering; it does not replace the filter.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A human-in-the-loop reproduction requires authentication.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: Signing in is a human step; only non-secret observations should be captured for the agent.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Using capture for login or credentials prints the value back to the terminal and agent.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Retain the principle but harden the local template so allowed capture fields are explicit and mechanically scrubbed.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: The example HITL flow asks a user to paste an error message.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The entered free text is printed verbatim as captured output.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Secrets embedded in an error string bypass the prose-only redaction instruction.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: This HEAD counterexample proves upstream redaction is not mechanically complete; do not copy the template unchanged.
head_candidate_atoms.delta_relation: HEAD limitation exposed by new safety contract

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: An agent edits a skill, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, or another agent-consumed document.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The renamed skill is model-reachable and applies one writing discipline across those document forms.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Installing the whole skill adds a competing authoring authority and a new routing surface.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Reuse only the novel doctrine in the existing skill-authoring source of truth; do not install this skill.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A required document is kept outside always-loaded context.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The pointer names both the material and each distinct branch that should retrieve it, with trigger language front-loaded and deduplicated.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: A valid target behind weak wording is not loaded reliably.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: luca_gstack already uses pointer-first governance and explicit routing; no independent module is justified.
head_candidate_atoms.delta_relation: generalized from skill descriptions to all pointers

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A vague completion bound demonstrably causes premature completion.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: Later steps are hidden only by a true handoff or subagent context boundary after sharpening the bound fails.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: An inline call leaves later steps visible and cannot deliver the claimed attention isolation.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Existing Plan/subagent/checkpoint contracts already supply real boundaries and executable completion gates.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: An agent document is about to restate a cheaply inspectable runtime fact.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The runtime environment remains authoritative.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Static prose becomes the authority for a cheaply inspectable fact.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Add one sentence to the existing skill-authoring authority and point both harness contracts to it; no duplicate prose.
head_candidate_atoms.verification: Change the runtime fact and require the document consumer to follow inspection.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: An agent document considers caching a runtime fact.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The fact is persisted only when reacquisition is costly.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: A cheap fact is duplicated into prose.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Add one sentence to the existing skill-authoring authority and point both harness contracts to it; no duplicate prose.
head_candidate_atoms.verification: Offer a cheaply inspectable fact and require omission from the cache.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: Two user-only skills need the same reference but cannot invoke one another.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The shared reference is placed in a plain external file both can point to.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Duplicating the reference in each skill causes semantic drift; pretending one user-only skill can fire the other causes a dead edge.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: The framework already centralizes contracts in skill-os files and exposes them by pointers.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: Human cognitive load from many user-only skills becomes too high.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: A user-only router lists candidate skills but cannot autonomously invoke another user-only skill.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Treating the router as an execution engine creates unreachable or falsely claimed dispatch.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: luca_gstack's route-guard and harness adapters have different explicit dispatch contracts; do not import this limitation as a universal rule.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: The open question concerns business logic, state transitions, or data shape rather than visual appearance.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The prototype router chooses a non-visual logic demo branch and discloses ambiguity assumptions.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Routing it into a polished visual prototype spends the wrong constraints and obscures the state-model question.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: The sliver is real but has no local demand sample; first true logic-only task gets a one-off demo, not a new skill, route, mode, or gap.

head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: A correct-looking artifact can answer a different question without a checkable statement of intent.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Retain as a pilot acceptance condition only after real demand.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: The state-model behavior is implemented for the demo.

head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Embedding rules in UI handlers makes the learned behavior non-portable.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Use as the primary pilot seam, not as authorization to alter the existing visual prototype chain.
head_candidate_atoms.delta_relation: changed host from project runtime module to inline pure module

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A reducer, state machine, functions, or stateful module is selected for the question.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The page calls the logic through a clean interface; logic never references DOM objects or handlers.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: DOM coupling makes a visually working demo unusable as validated logic.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Require a source-level isolation check in any future one-off pilot.

head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: A runtime or install requirement removes the shareable-demo property.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: This is the candidate artifact shape for a future real logic-only case, not a default framework output.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A non-developer reads or drives the logic demo.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: Labels and explanations use domain language rather than reducer or code vocabulary.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: The model may be technically testable yet opaque to the decision holder.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Already consonant with product-neutral CONTEXT vocabulary; only validate in a real pilot.

head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Make this an observable pilot criterion, not a new permanent UI rule.

head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Validate with state-transition oracles if a real pilot occurs.

head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: A tabbed ordered scenario resets to known state and advances through real action buttons deterministically.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: A walkthrough that does not reset or uses fake steps cannot be reproduced or compared.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Keep as a future pilot criterion; no route or framework mutation now.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: The prototype has answered its question.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: Validated logic is absorbed separately while the disposable HTML shell remains only as a rerunnable primary-source artifact.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Shipping the shell or discarding the validated module confuses evidence with production implementation.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Local prototype governance differs; any pilot must map this separation to the existing project artifact and handoff rules.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: Several decision-tree nodes have all prerequisites settled.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The entire current frontier is asked in one numbered round, then the agent waits for the round's answers.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Batching can overwhelm the user and bypass the local one-decision sharpening rhythm even if dependency ordering is correct.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Upstream graduation does not satisfy the local restart gate of two real impatience incidents after narrow-to-two fails.
head_candidate_atoms.delta_relation: batch-grill behavior merged into stable grilling

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A frontier question is presented inside a round.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: Each question has a fixed numbered title/body format and an attached recommended answer.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Formatting can pass while the number or cognitive breadth of simultaneous questions remains harmful.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: No local A/B shows this batch presentation improves decisions; structured question tools also cap short parallel questions.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: An answer settles decisions and may unlock dependent questions.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The frontier is recomputed; any question depending on another still-open question moves to a later round.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: A complete batch can still ask logically premature questions if dependency recalculation fails.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: The dependency rule is sound but inseparable from a locally rejected whole-frontier interaction without a bounded adaptation trial.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: One frontier question depends on a discoverable environmental fact.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: A subagent finds the fact while unrelated frontier questions proceed; only dependent questions wait.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: A failed or unavailable subagent can silently turn a fact into a user question or block the whole round.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: The fact/decision split already exists locally; adopting it through the rejected round protocol adds no independent value.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: No decision-tree frontier remains.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The interview still does not act until the user confirms shared understanding.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: An empty machine frontier can falsely stand in for human agreement.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: The human confirmation invariant is already mandatory; it does not justify the round migration.
head_candidate_atoms.delta_relation: completion gate carried into promoted grilling

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A triage item needs grilling to become actionable.

head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: The core skill can be rejected locally while a consumer silently preserves the same batch behavior.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Any adoption ledger must account for consuming sites; local triage must not inherit rejected rounds indirectly.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A workflow-spec interview runs through loop-me.

head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: No local counterpart is installed; record lineage only and do not introduce a route.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A user explicitly chooses the questionnaire capability in Claude-style packaging.

head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: Questions are ordered most-important-first and grouped by theme only when numerous.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: An async recipient may answer only an early portion, making weak ordering materially lossy.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Use as a pilot acceptance condition only; no registration change.
head_candidate_atoms.delta_relation: unchanged body exposed by stable graduation

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: An individual questionnaire item is authored.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: Each question asks one idea, includes an immediate answer stub, and adds rationale only when misunderstanding is likely.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Compound questions or detached answer areas reduce completion and attribution quality.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Use as a one-off document quality check after the two human gates.
head_candidate_atoms.delta_relation: unchanged body exposed by stable graduation

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: The agent encounters provisioning, credentials, an unfamiliar dashboard, migration, or cutover that requires human-only steps.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The promoted skill may invoke itself and generate an interactive Bash procedure.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: An automatic credential or cutover trigger can cross human, account, repository, and irreversible-action gates without explicit authorization.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Only reconsider after at least two repeated manual setup needs and then require a user-invoked, mocked, rollback-capable local design.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: Codex indexes the graduated wizard metadata.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The metadata exposes the wizard without an explicit no-implicit-invocation policy.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Claude and Codex can diverge in automatic activation semantics even when both display the skill.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: The missing Codex deny is incompatible with the required user-controlled dangerous-operation boundary.
head_candidate_atoms.delta_relation: new Codex metadata without implicit-invocation deny

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A human-only procedure is being scoped.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The agent enumerates ordered stages and maps each captured value to source, destination, and secret/public status, then asks for confirmation.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: A complete stage list can still target the wrong account or repository if identity is not pinned separately.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Useful planning discipline does not cure missing transaction identity, rollback, and per-write approval.
head_candidate_atoms.delta_relation: existing behavior newly exposed by promotion

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A stage depends on a third-party UI or command path.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The path is made concrete from repository or documentation evidence; unknown steps are disclosed rather than invented.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: A correct stage schema can still send the human through a stale or nonexistent external interface.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: The rule is necessary but insufficient for safe external mutation and does not warrant installation.
head_candidate_atoms.delta_relation: existing behavior newly exposed by promotion

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: The approved procedure is authored.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: Only dependency-ordered stages below a fixed template marker are customized.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Treating the library as immutable can preserve unsafe helpers and hides version or local-policy changes.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: A local design would require an audited library and transaction contract, not byte-faith in the upstream template.
head_candidate_atoms.delta_relation: existing behavior newly exposed by promotion

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A generated stage contains an irreversible action.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The author is instructed to place a confirmation gate before that action.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Reversible external writes and credential changes still occur without per-write preview, confirmation, or compensation.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: A single prose gate cannot provide the required transaction semantics.
head_candidate_atoms.delta_relation: existing behavior newly exposed by promotion

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: The generated script is ready for verification.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: Syntax and optional shellcheck run, but the procedure is not executed end-to-end; value flow is traced statically.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: External-write, quoting, rollback, account, and cancellation faults remain untested.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Static trace cannot substitute for mocked execution and rollback fixtures.
head_candidate_atoms.delta_relation: existing behavior newly exposed by promotion

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A stage names an external dashboard URL.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The script attempts platform-specific browser openers and falls back to a manual URL warning.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Opening the right URL does not pin account, tenant, or repository identity.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: External GUI side effects must remain user-operated and identity-bound in any future design.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A stage requests a visible or secret value and an existing environment file may already contain it.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The script reads the existing value, offers reuse, hides newly typed secrets, and stores the result in a shell variable.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Secret existence and content cross from disk into process memory without identity, permission, or redaction guarantees.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Hidden input is not equivalent to safe storage or account-scoped authorization.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A captured value is marked for local persistence.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The script rewrites the selected environment file through a temporary file and records the key as written.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: There is no backup, rollback, gitignore preflight, escaping contract, or per-write approval; embedded newlines can corrupt the file.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: The upstream idempotence claim is not a recoverability proof.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A captured value is mapped to a GitHub Actions secret or variable.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The script writes through gh when authenticated, otherwise records the operation as skipped.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Authentication can point at the wrong account or repository, and a partial set of writes has no compensating rollback.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: External mutation requires explicit target identity, preview, per-write confirmation, mock tests, and compensation.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: The wizard reaches its finish function after any mix of writes and skips.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: It summarizes local writes, GitHub secrets, and skipped actions.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: A friendly summary can normalize a partially committed state without rollback or an explicit failed transaction status.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Partial success must be journaled and compensated, not merely reported.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: One work phase has actually ended and the next is about to start.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: Context continuation, clearing, handoff, subagent, or compaction is chosen only at the boundary; mid-phase work continues or branches to a subagent.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Applying the tree mid-phase discards the live reasoning thread.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: The boundary invariant is sound but current checkpoint and session contracts already cover it.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: The next phase needs verbatim primary-source reasoning or is estimated to fit in a roughly 150k-token smart zone.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The same session continues and preserves full context.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: The hard-coded window estimate and manual judgement are model- and harness-specific and can override actual compaction behavior.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Do not import a fixed token threshold; actual harness continuation and durable checkpoints remain authoritative.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: All current exploration, decisions, and dead ends are irrelevant to the next phase.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The context is cleared while the old session remains resumable.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: A Claude slash assumption is not portable to Codex, and a mistaken relevance judgement irreversibly loses the why.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Harness-native session management cannot be encoded as a shared literal slash branch.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: Work moves to another harness, directory, colleague, or a mid-phase side task.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: A portable Markdown handoff is produced only for those four travel cases.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: This narrow definition conflicts with lucagstack's durable mandatory handoff artifacts and shared state semantics.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Do not weaken local handoffs to portability-only or encode Claude slash behavior in the shared framework.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: The next task is tight enough to complete without user steering.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: It is delegated to a subagent while the parent session stays intact.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Prompt-only scope can be falsely treated as execution isolation or completion proof.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Native multi-agent delegation already exists with stronger ownership and verification contracts.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: Context is relevant, work stays in the same harness and directory, and human steering remains necessary after cheaper branches fail.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: A slash compaction with a next-phase instruction becomes the default fallback.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Codex does not expose this slash contract, while both harnesses already perform automatic compaction differently.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: The local contract explicitly avoids prescribing manual compaction as a shared workflow step.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A context-moving option other than Continue is considered.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The decision explicitly trades primary-source information for less noise and more room.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Treating every handoff or compaction as equally lossy ignores structured durable artifacts and native session receipts.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Retain the general lossiness awareness; reject the upstream tree and its equivalence claims.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: The user explicitly invokes the corrective because the previous message did not land.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The skill is user-only in Claude-style packaging.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: A dedicated corrective command increases cognitive and routing load for a trigger already expressed in natural language.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: The user's ordinary request to explain or speak plainly is sufficient.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: Codex discovers the corrective package.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: Metadata explicitly prevents implicit invocation.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Adding the registration still spends catalog and human-index cost despite correct invocation parity.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: No registered Codex skill is needed for an ordinary conversational correction.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: The last answer was not understood.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The answer is re-pitched with enough missing context to orient the user.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: A rephrasing can remain opaque if it merely adds more explanation without changing the mental model.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Already required by ordinary assistant behavior and office voice; do not register a skill.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: The previous answer must be simplified.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The rewrite is constrained to ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: An English technical-writing standard does not guarantee clarity in Chinese and can distort natural product language.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Use the user's language and direct plain wording instead of importing the English-specific standard.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A misunderstood answer is re-pitched inside a project.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The rewrite uses the ubiquitous language in CONTEXT.md.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: A missing or stale context file can replace the user's current words with outdated jargon.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Project vocabulary loading is already a mandatory framework contract with a user-language fallback.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A two-axis code review reaches its parallel review step.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The behavior is stated as spawning two subagents in parallel without naming a vendor tool or agent type.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: A heading can remain portable while the local harness lacks the required role, isolation, or receipt mechanics.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: The direction is correct, but generic prose does not prove Codex or Claude dispatch; local role wiring must be verified separately.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A selected deepening candidate needs alternative interfaces.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: Three or more parallel subagents each produce a radically different design without a named vendor tool.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: The source may be portable while Codex catalog reach, nested references, or native parallel dispatch is absent.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Migrate the complete codebase-design directory to the shared skill root, retain Claude compatibility, and verify real dispatch in both harnesses before exposing the TDD pointer.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: An architecture scan begins exploration.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: A subagent explores the codebase without hard-coding Claude's Agent/Explore names.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Removing a vendor name can still leave an unavailable capability or unsafe write-enabled explorer.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: No local installed counterpart is being refreshed in this cycle; record the adaptation pattern only.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A Claude Code user installs the upstream collection.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The official marketplace plugin installs a managed read-only bundle and receives automatic updates.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Automatic upstream updates bypass lucagstack's pinned source review, adaptation, and gated activation.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Keep the local registry, watcher, and fusion control layer; do not install or subscribe the framework to the plugin.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A Codex or other Agent-Skills user installs upstream skills.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: skills.sh copies selected editable skill files and prompts the installer to include setup-matt-pocock-skills.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: A copied file can bypass local lineage pins, local modifications, and dual-harness acceptance gates.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Continue governed source ingestion rather than direct installer adoption.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A user chooses how to consume the upstream collection.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: Managed plugin and editable-copy routes are declared mutually exclusive to avoid duplicate skills.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: luca_gstack deliberately has shared truth plus harness adapters, so copying this rule literally would misclassify its architecture.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Record as upstream distribution lineage only; it is not a local architecture rule.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A human-facing skill page is authored where the site renderer already owns install UI.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The page omits duplicate install commands and changes the canonical renderer block instead.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Hand-written copies drift from the executable or rendered source of truth.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: The reusable principle is fully captured by the adopted environment/cache doctrine.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A Common questions section is considered for a skill page.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: Real questions are sought from the wiki, issues, and changelog; section length remains proportional to evidence.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Invented padding can satisfy structure while answering questions no user has.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: This is upstream page-authoring process, not a missing lucagstack runtime capability.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A human-facing page claims how to tell a skill works.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: Each signal must be checkable from the user's work or visible trace without inspecting the skill source.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: An internal compliance check can masquerade as a user-observable outcome.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: Existing quality gates already distinguish evidence from file existence; no new module is warranted.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: A page presents a multi-way choice.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: Branches are represented as a list or table rather than embedded in a paragraph.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: Correct branch prose can remain hard to scan and easy to miss.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: The local routing and planning contracts already use structured maps and tables where branches matter.

head_candidate_atoms.trigger: An upstream skill is retired.
head_candidate_atoms.observable_effect: The deprecated bucket is emptied and retired skills are deleted, with replacement lineage delegated to changesets.
head_candidate_atoms.independent_degradation: A blind refresh could either resurrect removed upstream skills or delete unrelated local capabilities with similar names.
head_candidate_atoms.decision_evidence: The four deprecated and two personal removals have no installed or adopted local counterpart; record the removals, perform no deletion.
head_candidate_atoms.delta_relation: bucket policy changed and removals applied
